name: Task Manager
description: Async task lifecycle management with SQLite persistence. Register, track, and retrieve results for long-running operations.
description_cn: 异步任务生命周期管理，基于 SQLite 持久化。注册、追踪和获取长耗时操作的结果。

directives.description: Query the status of an async task (pending/running/done/error).
Get the result of a completed task.
directives.description_cn: 获取已完成任务的结果。

directives.description: List all tasks with their current status.
directives.description_cn: 列出所有任务及当前状态。

directives.description: Get the tracking key for retrieving task output from cache.
directives.description_cn: 获取任务输出的缓存追踪键。

directives.description: Cancel a pending or running task.
directives.description_cn: 取消一个等待中或进行中的任务。
